posts.instagram:
Want to work in tech but don't have a degree?

Breaking Into Tech Without a Degree is a career guide for people who want to start in IT without a degree. It explores entry paths into IT help desk, cloud and cybersecurity.

It also covers the certifications to consider as you get started, so you can pick a direction and take a first step.

💻 Breaking Into Tech Without a Degree: IT Help Desk, Cloud, and Cybersecurity Entry Paths, Plus the Certifications to Start With, from TechVerse Technology Books
📖 Get it: apexlitpublishinggroup.com/books/81-breaking-into-tech-without-a-degree/
